subject: IPDF kickoff - pose uncertainty that survives symmetry
body:
Team,

Kicking off the IPDF track. Our release represents probability distributions over the rotation manifold SO(3) implicitly - the model scores (image, rotation) pairs, so a symmetric object naturally gets a multi-modal pose distribution instead of a single wrong answer with high confidence. For data-platforms this slots into the pose-labeling pipeline: calibrated pose uncertainty is what downstream auto-labeling gates on, and current regressors are confidently wrong on symmetric parts.

Scope: reproduce the SYMSOL I results from the released configs, benchmark evaluation cost (the dense rotation-grid evaluation is the known expensive bit), and prototype the labeling-pipeline integration on our internal parts set.

Milestones: SYMSOL repro by end of May, cost benchmark and the big eval sweep in June, integration recommendation by 2026-07-06.

Yara leads research, Katya experiments, Nikhil integration, Leilani infra. Santiago - resourcing note please, including the June compute booking.

Dmitri
